housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 1,126 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Venice city centre; a deposit norm and main local rental portal were not grounded.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that a foreign citizen resident in Italy needs an Italian tax code for its XME account; online identification uses an electronic identity card, passport or driving licence, with a health card when requested.
required_docs: Electronic identity card, passport or driving licence for online identification; health card when requested

schools.summary: A Venice schools directory lists IB, British and Cambridge IGCSE curricula among local international schools.

legal_admin.summary: New residents submit a complete residence declaration to the Venice municipal registry; the Ufficio Soggiorno cittadini comunitari handles EU and British registrations and also records habitual-residence declarations and residence permits for non-EU citizens.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a complete residence declaration to the Venice municipal registry using the channel applicable to the newcomer status.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax ID is the codice fiscale. Eligible foreign nationals without one submit signed form AA4/8 and valid identification to a Revenue Agency office; immigration authorities assign it in specified permit processes.

transport.summary: The ACTV Rete Unica network covers Venice urban waterborne, mainland bus, Lido bus, tram and People Mover services; the standard monthly pass costs EUR 37. A driving-licence exchange rule and healthcare-registration procedure could not be represented with the single service source URL without losing fact-level sourcing.
